premise: Mouse cannot cross the stream; Deer is too tall to help; Beaver gnaws a stick to just the right point and builds a little path of sticks and mud.
inspiration: The Lion and the Mouse (Aesop), turned: not the biggest helper but the right one, and help built to the size of the one who needs it.
lesson: The best help fits the one you're helping.
learning: Beavers build with sticks and mud

en-US.title: Beaver Builds a Way Across
en-US.text: {sfx:stream-bed} Splish, splash, went the stream. {mouse:enter} Mouse scampered up, on his way to Grandma's. {mouse:live} He sniffed. He stood on tiptoe to look across… then dropped down and washed his face. {mouse:face sad} [sad] Too wide for a mouse. {deer:enter} Deer came walking by, tall and gentle. {deer:live} He nibbled the grass, thinking. He looked up, flicked his ears and wagged his tail. {deer:face happy} Hop on my back! But Deer was so tall that Mouse {mouse:wobble} felt dizzy looking up. Then {beaver:enter} Beaver waddled up with his stick. {beaver:face happy} [excited] Leave it to me! {beaver:live hold} He gnawed it, crunch-crunch, chips flying, and held it up to look. {mouse:face surprised} Mouse held his breath. {beaver:live resume} Beaver patted his stick proudly. Just right! Stick, stick, mud. Stick, stick, mud. [gasps] A little path across the water, just the size of a mouse! {mouse:face happy} {mouse:hop x3} Mouse scampered over, {frog:enter} Frog {frog:hop} cheered, and on the other side, Grandma {mouse:hearts} was waiting with a hug.

es-ES.title: Castor construye un camino
es-ES.text: {sfx:stream-bed} Chip, chap, hacía el arroyo. {mouse:enter} Ratón llegó correteando; iba a casa de su abuela. {mouse:live} Olfateó. Se puso de puntillas para mirar al otro lado… luego bajó y se lavó la cara. {mouse:face sad} [sad] Demasiado ancho para un ratón. {deer:enter} Ciervo pasaba por allí, alto y tranquilo. {deer:live} Mordisqueó la hierba, pensando. Luego levantó la cabeza, movió las orejas y meneó la colita. {deer:face happy} ¡Súbete a mi lomo! Pero Ciervo era tan alto que a Ratón {mouse:wobble} le entró vértigo de mirar. Entonces {beaver:enter} Castor llegó anadeando con su palo. {beaver:face happy} [excited] ¡Déjamelo a mí! {beaver:live hold} Lo royó, cric-crac, saltaban astillas, y lo levantó para mirarlo. {mouse:face surprised} Ratón contuvo el aliento. {beaver:live resume} Castor dio unas palmaditas a su palo. ¡Perfecto! Palo, palo, barro. Palo, palo, barro. [gasps] ¡Un caminito sobre el agua, justo del tamaño de un ratón! {mouse:face happy} {mouse:hop x3} Ratón cruzó correteando, {frog:enter} Rana {frog:hop} aplaudió, y al otro lado, la abuela {mouse:hearts} lo esperaba con un abrazo.

stream-bed.prompt: a small babbling forest stream over pebbles, calm
